segments.text: BVT, that it may the better bee vnderſtoode, that by the name, Ieſus, the office of the Sonne of GOD the Mediatour is deſigned, theſe foure queſtions are to be conſidered.

1 What is ſignified by the word Ieſus.
2 From what euils he ſaieth or deliuereth.
3 How he ſaueth.
4 Whom he ſaueth.
